title: Lawrence Dewey in Lafayette and Wilman Bro
summary: Talk of visiting Dewey in Lafayette and whether Lawrence knows bassist Wilman Bro.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Well, you'll be sure and tell him hello for me. All right. I'm married from Bro. I guess you know Wilman Bro.
He's a bass player. He used to play bass with Duke Collinger. No. And he's from Cross River around Donaldsonville.
I know you'd know him if you saw him.
Oh, yeah. I guess I know him.
He played Madeline and off the trombone, played several instruments. He went out to see Dewey, I believe the last time he was here with my partner, Bill Russell.
